title: The Arena Group is renaming itself Paradium.AI, and its revenue just halved
excerpt: The Arena Group is renaming itself Paradium.AI by the end of August. Second-quarter revenue fell to $22.2m from $45.0m a year earlier.
content_html:
The Arena Group is renaming itself Paradium.AI. The publisher of TheStreet, Parade and Men’s Journal expects the change to finish by the end of August.

Business Insider had it first. Steven Tweedie and Ben Shimkus obtained a staff memo from chief executive Paul Edmondson, confidential until 4:05 PM ET, five minutes after the closing bell.

The announcement that followed carried three more things. Arena refinanced its debt, closed its acquisition of InfoSentience and launched a production platform called Cutter Studios.

The quarter underneath the new name

Revenue for the second quarter came in at $22.2m. A year earlier it was $45.0m.

Gross margin fell with it, from 56.4% to 39.2%. Adjusted EBITDA reached $4.4m, against $18.6m in the same quarter of 2025.

The net loss itself is small, at $0.2m. The year-ago comparison is the strange one, because Arena booked $108.6m of net income in the second quarter of 2025, worth 241.3% of that quarter’s revenue.

Cash stood at $11.2m at the end of June, and operations generated $2.1m during the quarter.

What the company says it is becoming

Edmondson calls this the turn. “We believe this quarter marks the official pivot point where our operational groundwork has converted into a durable technology advantage,” he said.

The direction he describes points away from the business Arena has been. The company is “moving decisively away from legacy publishing and emerging as a differentiated technology company built to empower independent creators”.

Three things carry that claim. InfoSentience supplies an automated data engine, Cutter Studios produces and distributes AI-made video and articles, and Encore holds the company’s first-party data.

Edmondson was making a version of this argument in May. He said then that the first quarter had given the company the insights it needed, after it aggressively accelerated its AI adoption.

The machine that writes the sports scores

InfoSentience turns numbers into sentences. Arena calls it a deterministic, high-volume narrative engine, and it made its name in sport, where MaxPreps counts as its best-known partner.

Arena bought it with cash on hand, and expects the deal to lift earnings this year. Livmo acted as sell-side adviser.

Steve Wasick, who founded InfoSentience, stays on. The engine keeps serving its existing third-party clients, and Arena wants it chasing new ones.

The new name is already in use. The acquisition release calls the company The Arena Group Holdings, doing business as Paradium.AI, weeks before the rebrand formally completes.

Arena’s case for the deal is that automation frees reporters. It wants editorial staff to move past manual data processing and towards what it calls high-impact investigative journalism.

Ryan Bonini, general manager for sports and leisure, puts it in blunter terms. He calls the acquisition “a pivotal shift from traditional publishing to a robust technology infrastructure”.

The debt is the quiet part

Arena extended its existing credit facility with its current lender, and pushed the maturity out by three years. It did not disclose the size of the facility.

Geoffrey Wait, the principal financial officer, called that an important milestone. The transaction “eliminates a significant near-term uncertainty”, he said, and avoids unnecessary equity dilution.

That is the part of Monday that moves the company’s position. A rebrand is a decision, and three more years of runway is a fact.

Why a publisher reaches for the suffix

The traffic that funded this business is going elsewhere. Reddit told investors that Google’s AI answers cut its search referrals, and Reddit sits far closer to the source than Arena does.

Some publishers are trying to charge for the same material instead. Cloudflare built a system to block AI crawlers unless the model companies pay for what they take.

Others simply cut. BuzzFeed went through layoffs and a pivot as its own traffic fell, a sequence Arena’s investors will recognise.

A rename is not a strategy

Renaming to fit the moment is a well-worn move. Freepik rebranded as Magnific around its AI tools. The conference circuit has done it too, with SaaStock dropping SaaS from its own name.

Edmondson’s own framing invites the scepticism. “AI has created an inflection point in digital media where you either evolve or get left behind,” he said.

The ticker does not change. Arena stays AREN on NYSE American, and the titles stay too, from Parade and Athlon Sports to ShopHQ, TravelHost and the Adventure Sports Network.

What has to change is the number at the top. Revenue halved in a quarter, and the case for the new name rests on tools with no public track record yet. Whether the letters after the dot change what an advertiser pays is the only question here that money answers.

content_html_zh:
Arena Group 正在更名为 Paradium.AI。 《TheStreet》、《Parade》和《Men’s Journal》的出版商预计这一变化将在八月底完成。

《商业内幕》首先报道了这一点。 Steven Tweedie 和 Ben Shimkus 从首席执行官 Paul Edmondson 那里获得了一份员工备忘录，该备忘录在美国东部时间下午 4:05（收市后五分钟）之前保密。

随后的公告还包含三件事。 Arena 对其债务进行了再融资，完成了对 InfoSentience 的收购，并推出了一个名为 Cutter Studios 的制作平台。

新名称下方的季度

第二季度收入为 2220 万美元。 一年前该数字为 4500 万美元。

毛利率也随之下降，从 56.4% 降至 39.2%。 调整后 EBITDA 达到 440 万美元，而 2025 年同一季度为 1,860 万美元。

净损失本身很小，为 20 万美元。 与去年同期的比较很奇怪，因为 Arena 在 2025 年第二季度实现净利润 1.086 亿美元，占该季度收入的 241.3%。

截至 6 月底，现金为 1120 万美元，本季度运营收入为 210 万美元。

该公司所说的正在成为

埃德蒙森称之为“转牌”。 他表示：“我们相信，本季度标志着我们的运营基础已转变为持久技术优势的正式转折点。”

他所描述的方向已经远离了商业竞技场。 该公司正在“果断地摆脱传统出版业，并成为一家旨在为独立创作者提供支持的差异化技术公司”。

三件事证明了这一点。 InfoSentience 提供自动化数据引擎，Cutter Studios 制作和分发人工智能制作的视频和文章，Encore 持有该公司的第一方数据。

埃德蒙森五月份提出了这一论点的一个版本。 他当时表示，在积极加速人工智能采用之后，第一季度为该公司提供了所需的见解。

书写体育比赛成绩的机器

InfoSentience 将数字转化为句子。 Arena 称其为确定性、大容量的叙事引擎，并在体育领域成名，MaxPreps 是其最著名的合作伙伴。

Arena 用手头现金购买了它，并预计这笔交易将提高今年的收益。 Livmo 担任卖方顾问。

InfoSentience 的创始人 Steve Wasick 留任。 该引擎继续为现有的第三方客户提供服务，Arena 希望它能够追逐新客户。

新名称已被使用。 在品牌重塑正式完成前几周，收购公告称该公司为 The Arena Group Holdings，以 Paradium.AI 名义开展业务。

Arena 的交易理由是自动化解放了记者。 它希望编辑人员摆脱手动数据处理，转向所谓的高影响力调查性新闻。

体育和休闲总经理瑞安·博尼尼 (Ryan Bonini) 的说法更为直白。 他称此次收购是“从传统出版向强大技术基础设施的关键转变”。

债务是安静的部分

Arena 延长了与当前贷方的现有信贷额度，并将到期日推迟了三年。 它没有透露该设施的规模。

首席财务官杰弗里·韦特 (Geoffrey Wait) 称这是一个重要的里程碑。 他表示，此次交易“消除了近期的重大不确定性”，并避免了不必要的股权稀释。

这是周一改变该公司立场的部分。 品牌重塑是一个决定，三年的跑道已是事实。

为什么出版商会使用后缀

为这项业务提供资金的流量正在流向其他地方。 Reddit 告诉投资者，谷歌的人工智能答案减少了其搜索推荐，而 Reddit 比 Arena 更接近来源。

一些出版商正试图对相同的材料收费。 Cloudflare 构建了一个系统来阻止 AI 爬虫，除非模型公司支付费用。

其他人干脆砍掉。 随着流量下降，BuzzFeed 经历了裁员和转型，Arena 的投资者会认识到这一过程。

更名不是策略

为了适应当下而重命名是一个老掉牙的举动。 Freepik 围绕其人工智能工具更名为 Magnific。 巡回会议也做到了这一点，SaaStock 从自己的名字中删除了 SaaS。

埃德蒙森自己的框架引起了怀疑。 他说：“人工智能已经在数字媒体领域创造了一个拐点，你要么进化，要么落后。”

股票代码不会改变。 Arena 在纽约证券交易所美国网站上保留了 AREN，并且标题也保留了下来，从 Parade 和 Athlon Sports 到 ShopHQ、TravelHost 和 Adventure Sports Network。

需要改变的是顶部的数字。 收入在一个季度内减半，而新名称的理由取决于尚未公开跟踪记录的工具。 点后面的字母是否会改变广告商支付的费用是金钱可以回答的唯一问题。
